arabic text: KYA DAIKHTI HAI SUGHRA ZAYNAB KAY AANSUON MEI\nMANZER HAI KERBALA KA ZAYNAB KAY AANSUON MEI
english translation text: WHAT DOES SUGHRA SEE IN ZAYNAB'S TEARS\nTHE STORY OF KARBALA IS IN ZAYNAB’S (A) TEARS

arabic text: BARCHI KA ZAKHM TAAZA TA ZINDAGI RAHAY GAA\nAKBAR KA HAI KALAYJA ZAYNAB KAY AANSUON MEI
english translation text: THE WOUND OF THE ARROW WILL STAY FRESH FOR A LIFE\nTIME. IT IS AKBAR'S (A) ARROW-BOUND HEART IN ZAYNAB'S (A) TEARS

arabic text: SUGHRA NAZAR UTHAO QASIM KA HAAL DAIKHO\nBIKHRA HUA HAI LAASHA ZAYNAB KAY AANSUON MEI
english translation text: SUGHRA LOOK UP AND SEE WHAT HAS BECOME OF QASIM\n(A), THERE’S A SCATTERED BODY IN ZAYNAB'S (A) TEARS

arabic text: AEY DEEDA-E-TASAVER TUJH KO DIKHAEE DAY GAA\nCHOTA SA AIK JHOOLA ZAYNAB KAY AANSUON MEI
english translation text: IF YOU LOOK CLOSELY YOU WILL BE ABLE TO SEE\nA SMALL CRIB IN ZAYNAB'S (A) TEARS

arabic text: ZINDAN-E-SHAAM MEI HAI CHOTI SI QABAR LAIKIN\nMOJOUD HAI SAKINA ZAYNAB KAY AANSUON MEI
english translation text: THERE’S IS A SMALL GRAVE IN THE PRISON OF\nSHAAM, SAKINA STILL IS PRESENT IN ZAINAB'S (A) TEARS

arabic text: SHABBIR PAYSH-E-DAVAR JAEYNGAI SAATH LAY KER\nBHEEGA HUA AMAAMA ZAYNAB KAY AANSUON MEI
english translation text: WHEN SHABBIR (A) WILL GO BEFORE ALLAH (SWT) HE WILL HAVE\nWITH HIM, HIS TURBAN THAT IS SOAKED WITH ZAYNAB'S (A) TEARS

arabic text: BAY PARDAGI KA AALAM KAISAY ADEEL LIKHAY\nKHUD DAIKHLAY ZAMANA ZAYNAB KAY AANSUON MEI
english translation text: HOW WILL ADEEL NARRATE THE STORY OF THE HIJABS BEING TAKEN, THE\nPAIN IS CLEAR FOR THE WORLD TO SEE IN ZAYNAB'S (A) TEARS
